skill.name: emaildeliverabilityskill
skill.description: Plan, review, and improve email deliverability workflows for inbox placement, authentication, sender reputation, complaint control, and remediation.
skill.summary: Audit email deliverability risks and build approval-gated remediation plans.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns across this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, code execution, network access, credential handling, or unsafe autonomous action intent. The skill requires explicit approval for high-risk email system changes.

content.value_statement: Email deliverability problems can hide across DNS, reputation, list quality, and provider behavior. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code build clear audits, triage notes, and remediation plans.
actual_capabilities: Classifies deliverability issues such as authentication failure, bounce spikes, complaint spikes, spam placement, throttling, blocklists, and engagement decay.
Guides evidence collection by sending domain, provider, segment, campaign, and time window.
Reviews SPF, DKIM, DMARC, tracking domains, bounce domains, alignment, and recent DNS changes.
Checks list acquisition, consent, suppression, frequency, reactivation, and recent imports for reputation risk.
Builds staged remediation plans with stop-loss thresholds, monitoring cadence, and action owners.
Requires explicit approval before DNS edits, suppression changes, imports, provider migrations, or production throttling.
limitations: It does not send email, import contacts, edit DNS, or change suppression rules automatically.
It needs accurate data from email platforms, postmaster tools, blocklist checks, and campaign reports.
It does not replace legal review for consent, unsubscribe, or complaint handling obligations.
Recommendations depend on current sender history and provider-specific evidence.

use_cases.title: Audit Domain Authentication
use_cases.description: Review SPF, DKIM, DMARC, tracking, bounce, and alignment evidence before a campaign or migration.

use_cases.title: Triage Reputation Incidents
use_cases.description: Separate complaint, bounce, blocklist, provider, and list-quality causes before choosing a remediation path.

use_cases.title: Plan Controlled Sending Ramps
use_cases.description: Create warmup schedules with monitoring cadence, stop-loss thresholds, and explicit approval gates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit DNS Authentication
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a clear authentication review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildeliverabilityskill to review SPF, DKIM, DMARC, tracking domain, and bounce domain status. Separate missing records from alignment failures.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Complaint Spike
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate incident review after complaints increase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildeliverabilityskill to analyze a complaint spike by provider, campaign, segment, consent source, recent imports, and time window. Recommend pause and resume thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Build Warmup Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a new domain or provider migration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildeliverabilityskill to create a warmup plan tied to volume, complaint rate, bounce rate, engagement, and mailbox provider response.

prompt_templates.title: Design Recovery Runbook
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recovery planning for a damaged sender reputation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildeliverabilityskill to build a recovery runbook covering blocklists, bounces, complaints, suppression review, owner assignments, monitoring, and approval gates.

output_examples.input: A new sending domain needs authentication review before campaign launch.
output_examples.output: A DNS audit separates SPF, DKIM, DMARC, tracking domain, and bounce-domain checks, then lists approvals before changes.

output_examples.input: Complaint rate increased after a reactivation campaign.
output_examples.output: A triage note segments complaints by source and campaign, pauses risky sends, and defines continue, slow, or stop thresholds.

output_examples.input: A sender needs a ramp plan after provider migration.
output_examples.output: A warmup schedule ties volume to complaint, bounce, engagement, and provider signals, with daily monitoring and owner assignments.

best_practices: Provide domain, provider, segment, campaign, and time-window data before requesting remediation.
Keep live DNS, suppression, import, migration, and automation changes behind explicit approval.
Segment complaint and bounce rates by source and campaign before changing content or volume.
anti_patterns: Treating all mailbox providers, campaigns, and contact sources as one stream.
Increasing send volume before resolving complaint, bounce, or authentication issues.
Editing DNS or suppression rules without an owner, approval record, and rollback plan.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning, review, and recommendations. Live sends require explicit human approval.

faq.question: Can it check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC?
faq.answer: It guides the review and explains alignment issues. You must provide DNS records or trusted lookup results.

faq.question: Can it help recover sender reputation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create staged recovery plans with pause criteria, monitoring cadence, and resume thresholds.

faq.question: Does it replace an email service provider tool?
faq.answer: No. It depends on provider reports, postmaster tools, blocklist checks, and campaign metrics.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide domains, providers, recent campaigns, imports, metrics, blocklist results, and the time window involved.

faq.question: Is it suitable for compliance-sensitive lists?
faq.answer: It includes consent and suppression review, but legal or compliance review may still be required.
